findings.description: The single-path check was changed from `isinstance(filename, str)` to `isinstance(filename, os.PathLike)`, so a plain `str` filename is no longer wrapped in a tuple before being passed to `edit_files`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: calling `click.edit(filename="notes.txt")` with a str. Mechanism: `str` is not `os.PathLike`, so the string is passed unwrapped to `ed.edit_files`, which iterates it character by character and tries to open files named 'n', 'o', 't', and so on. Impact: the editor opens wrong or nonexistent files for every existing str-based call, a silent regression on a common path. The condition needs to accept both types, e.g. `isinstance(filename, (str, os.PathLike))`.
